[EN] Far too many orcans are happy to war with the federation forever. That way lies ruin and death.

The {@LinkCreature:41#4004#Black Claw berserkers}, {@LinkCreature:41#4005#slaughterers}, and {@LinkCreature:41#3006#blood fighters} are the most warlike of all. I would like to take their insane eyes to {@LinkCreature:241#1023$$Majduk} as proof of their madness. Will you help me do this?
[ES] Demasiados orcanos están felices de hacer la guerra a la federación para siempre. Ese camino conduce a la ruina y a la muerte.

Los {@LinkCreature:41#4004#Black Claw berserkers}, {@LinkCreature:41#4005#slaughterers} y {@LinkCreature:41#3006#blood fighters} son los más belicosos de todos. Me gustaría llevar sus ojos dementes a {@LinkCreature:241#1023$$Majduk} como prueba de su locura. ¿Me ayudarás a hacer esto?

[EN] Now I'll take these eyes to the other tribes and try to convince them to lay down their arms. Thank you, .
[ES] Ahora llevaré estos ojos a las otras tribus e intentaré convencerlas de que depongan las armas. Gracias, .

[EN] Kill the {@LinkCreature:41#4004#Black Claw berserkers}, {@LinkCreature:41#4005#slaughterers}, and {@LinkCreature:41#3006#blood fighters} and bring me their eyeballs.
[ES] Mata a los {@LinkCreature:41#4004#Black Claw berserkers}, {@LinkCreature:41#4005#slaughterers} y {@LinkCreature:41#3006#blood fighters} y tráeme sus globos oculares.
